# Data policy

Our customers' names and e-mail addresses, and anything kept beside them,
stay in the shop's database. That database has its database server to
itself: no other database of ours may be put on the same server. Only the
web shop's account reads them, and only the e-mail, the name and the
order number leave, to the mail provider. An order's customer number
stays in the shop's database too. Everything else, the reporting
database's figures included, is not restricted.
